SELECT r.RE_NUM AS rentalId, r.RE_NAME AS rentalName, r.RE_REGION AS rg_name, ROUND(AVG(rv.RV_RATING), 1) AS avgRating, COUNT(rv.RV_NUM) AS reviewCount,
c.CR_ID AS carId, c.CR_YEAR AS carYear, c.CR_FUEL_TYPE AS carFuel, c.CR_TRANS AS carTrans, c.CR_PRICE AS carPrice, c.CR_THUMBNAIL AS thumbnail
FROM RENTAL r JOIN CAR c ON r.RE_NUM = c.CR_RE_NUM JOIN CAR_TYPE ct ON c.CR_CT_KEY = ct.CT_KEY LEFT JOIN REVIEW rv ON rv.RV_TABLE_NAME = 'rental' AND rv.RV_NUMBER = r.RE_NUM LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cp.CP_CR_ID, COUNT(*) AS reserved_count FROM RE_RESERVATION rr JOIN CAR_PACKAGE cp ON rr.RR_CP_NUM = cp.CP_NUM WHERE rr.RR_STATE = '예약완료' AND (rr.RR_CHECKIN < #{checkout} AND rr.RR_CHEKOUT > #{checkin}) GROUP BY cp.CP_CR_ID ) res ON c.CR_ID = res.CP_CR_ID
WHERE r.RE_REGION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{rg_name}, '%') AND c.CR_CT_KEY = #{ct_key} AND c.CR_YEAR = #{cr_year} AND c.CR_FUEL_TYPE = #{cr_fuel_type} AND c.CR_TRANS = #{cr_trans} AND (c.CR_COUNT - IFNULL(res.reserved_count, 0)) > 0
GROUP BY r.RE_NUM, c.CR_ID ORDER BY c.CR_PRICE ASC

SELECT r.*, ROUND(AVG(rv.rv_rating), 1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(rv.rv_num) AS review_count FROM rental r LEFT JOIN review rv ON rv.rv_table_name = 'rental' AND rv.rv_number = r.re_num WHERE r.re_num = #{re_num}
mapper.insert: insert into rental(re_name, re_number, re_region, re_me_num, re_rg_num) value(#{re_name},#{re_number},#{re_region},#{re_me_num},#{re_rg_num})
